# Agent Journal (structured notes)

## Findings
- Ticket #26813 (TASK.md): cause is `ModelChoiceField.__init__` (django/forms/models.py ~L1184) defaulting `empty_label="---------"`, so `ModelChoiceIterator` always yields a blank choice; RadioSelect renders it as a checked "-------" radio. Select hides it visually, RadioSelect can't.
- Fix applied (matches upstream commit da79ee472d, which applies cleanly at this checkout 335c9c94ac): `ModelChoiceField.__init__(..., blank=False)` → `empty_label=None` when widget is RadioSelect and not blank; `ForeignKey.formfield` passes `'blank': self.blank`.
- Verified: repro script (TestRun/BatchData from ticket) renders no blank radio; runtests model_forms 169 OK; model_forms+forms_tests 818 OK (1 skip); admin_widgets+admin_views 437 OK (29 skips). Tests untouched, nothing committed.
